cases.actions: Fresh context; use real click and typing for sticky activation; enter work and select/date choices; preview; browser reload; dismiss native beforeunload; assert full values, active panel and preview unchanged. Repeat reload accept; defaults may replace edits.
cases.expectation: One native beforeunload on dirty reload; dismiss retains; accept leaves/reloads. No custom confirm substituted.

cases.actions: Dirty page with real activation; click existing same-tab header link; dismiss; verify retention; repeat accept; reach parent page.
cases.expectation: Dirty same-tab link protected by native beforeunload.

cases.actions: Navigate from parent to workbench through actual link or same-tab navigation; dirty via real interaction; browser history Back dismiss, then accept. Revisit forward and document bfcache/restored-control behaviour.
cases.expectation: Back warning while dirty when engine supports it; retention on dismiss; restored values reconcile on pageshow. Natural bfcache retention is valid.

cases.actions: Fresh defaults reload/link/Back; dirty then restore exact default using textarea, select, date; Save JSON then reload; successful reopen then reload; confirmed clear then reload.
cases.expectation: No beforeunload while clean, including listener removal after checkpoints or reversion.

cases.actions: Dirty notes, navigate Next/Back/step buttons, preview, guide new tab, V2 new tab, feedback new tab; block outbound requests and record destinations.
cases.expectation: No leave warning or note loss; no notes in destination URLs or requests; no external writes.

cases.actions: Dirty notes; request text export and assert still dirty; request JSON and inspect exact emitted payload; cancel device retention via Playwright download cancellation where supported; edit again. Separately inject synchronous object-URL creation failure and anchor-click failure; then attempt reload dismiss.
cases.expectation: Text export does not clean; synchronous JSON failure stays dirty; normal request establishes captured checkpoint despite unobservable OS retention; wording says requested and never guarantees retained/safe/approved.

cases.actions: Observe changes-status role=status text and mutation count; type several characters while dirty; return to checkpoint; select/date changes using change event; successful reopen; cancelled replacement; invalid import; cancelled clear.
cases.expectation: Status reflects checkpoint-relative changes, no repeated announcements per dirty keystroke; cancelling/invalid imports preserve tracking. No green safe/approval claim.

cases.actions: Record network requests and storage APIs after load; exercise notes, preview, JSON/text requests, failed download, transitions and imports. Inspect local/session storage, cookies, IndexedDB databases and service-worker registrations where APIs exist.
cases.expectation: No persistence, remote writes, telemetry or automatic downloads. Browser engine state/bfcache is not persistence added by app.

browser_matrix: installed Google Chrome if available, else Chromium with explicit label
limits: Real native browser dialogs must be observed from Playwright dialog events after genuine click/key activation. If engine/harness lacks beforeunload support, document unsupported capability separately; do not infer product defect. File chooser tests via setInputFiles do not establish native OS picker cancel. Browser/process crash, OS tab-close, mobile kill and actual retained-file confirmation remain unverified. No human validation claimed.
first_result_policy: Append first per-case result/failure before any adapter or rerun; preserve first files; reruns separate. Harness adapters may probe controls or intercept local browser APIs for failure injection; never feed expectations/case IDs into app logic.
